context:
看著☄️蓋的🏘️，在決定要選哪一間的🌸。

🌸：選哪個來當🌸家好呢？別莊。大家覺得哪個好呢？
（看著左側那幢。）嗯⋯就這個吧！

於是，🌸放了一塊牌子在那房子的大門上方，當作門牌，寫上：咪口的別莊。

此時，☄️從這間房子裡走了出來，回頭看到🌸放的牌子，☄️立即砍了那個門牌。

🌸：啊啊！！嗚⋯（櫻兒哭聲。）

☄️砍完轉身進屋，🌸也跟著進去。

🌸：Tsk⋯！這可是咪口的別⋯不可以嗎？

☄️又走出屋子，🌸也跟著走出。☄️抬頭，示意要🌸往上面看。

🌸抬頭一看，在大門的右上方更高處已經有一塊空白木牌。

🌸：啊！是希望我寫在這裡的意思嗎？

☄️看著🌸，然後點了點頭。

🌸：（可愛音。）彗醬～！

🌸看著☄️又轉身進屋子裡。

🌸便在那木牌寫上：咪口別莊。

🌸別莊！哇ㄚㄚ～～別莊！（很高興的進屋子裡去。）咪口的別莊！

Looking at the houses ☄️ built, 🌸 was deciding which one to choose.

🌸: Which one should I pick as my home? A villa… What does everyone think?
(Looking at the one on the left.) Hmm… I’ll go with this one!

So, 🌸 started writing a door plate: “Miko’s Villa.”

At that moment, ☄️ walked out of that house, turned around, saw the door plate 🌸 had placed, and immediately destroyed it.

🌸: Ahhh!! Ugh… (Sakura’s crying sound.)

After destroying the sign, ☄️ turned around and went back inside. 🌸 followed after.

🌸: Tsk…! This is Miko’s vil— Is that not allowed?

☄️ walked out of the house again, and 🌸 followed. ☄️ then tilted their head upward, signaling 🌸 to look up.

When 🌸 looked up, they saw a blank wooden sign already placed in the upper right corner of the entrance.

🌸: Ah! Does this mean you want me to write it here?

☄️ looked at 🌸 and nodded.

🌸: (In a cute voice.) Sui-chan~!

Watching ☄️ turn back and enter the house, 🌸 then wrote on the wooden sign: “Miko Villa.”

🌸: A villa! Waaah~~ A villa! (Excitedly runs inside.) Miko’s Villa!
